arm_describe.label: the deployed controller's own proposals, from the Test C blind runs
arm_describe.why: The regenerated arm 1 is a reconstruction of the proposal mechanism from stored parents. This arm is the run itself: every attempt the controller actually made, in round order, with the charged calls marked, so a first CALL index exists here and nowhere else in this harness.

payload.information_regime_statement: Offline structural evaluator. The atlas destinations are published task answers; they are read only to SCORE proposals after the fact and are never passed to the proposal mechanism, an initialization, a library or a prior. Zero charged oracle calls.
